text:
samir: Heads-up — after pushing 550.x driver to edge-pool (us-west2) some nodes are hanging in boot, DKMS failing during firstboot. Not widespread yet but ~12 nodes are stuck and provisioning is timing out.

jess: Any logs from the nodes? kernel/dkms traces?

samir: Paste of the relevant portion from a stuck host:
```
[    12.345678] dkms: Building module nvidia/550.XX for kernel 6.2.0-45-generic...
ERROR: Cannot find the tree for the current kernel (6.2.0-45-generic)
Consult /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.XX/build/make.log for more information.
[    13.210123] modprobe: ERROR: could not insert 'nvidia_uvm': Exec format error
[    13.210130] systemd[1]: Failed to start NVIDIA UVM Management daemon.
core: cloud-init: unit netplan-wait-online.service: Job for netplan-wait-online.service failed because the control process exited with error code.
```

leo: Looks like kernel header mismatch + DKMS ordering problem. Those nodes were on a live-updated kernel image (6.2) but provisioning image expects different headers. We've seen `Exec format error` when kernel modules built against different build tree.

anna: Also seeing network manager race — netplan waiting on `nvidia` module udev rule that delays network bringup which blocks cloud-init -> docker socket -> provisioning agent. That cascades and times out our orchestration, marking nodes unhealthy.

jess: Can we bail the rollout and revert to 535 for edge-pool? What's canary status?

samir: Canary (5 hosts) succeeded earlier but those were on older kernels. The staged rollout included nodes with a kernel-autoupdate flag; those hit the mismatch. I want to pause the rollout.

infra-bot: [AUTO] Deploy pipeline edge-pool-driver-550 started at 2410001200. Canary: 5 succeeded, Staged: 120 of 500 in progress, 12 failures reported.

jess: Ok pausing now. @oncall can you coordinate rollback for nodes that failed to provision and stop the fleet rollout? Also need a short postmortem note for the runbook.

oncall: On it — I'll cancel remaining jobs and queue a rollback for the 12 failed nodes. ETA 15m for orchestration run. What rollback image/tag?

leo: Rollback to `driver-535-2026-03-01` (the stable tag). We should also patch the provisioning workflow to check kernel/header parity before assigning driver update job.

anna: Temporary mitigation for stuck nodes: drop to rescue, chroot and run `dkms install -m nvidia -v 535.XX` then `update-initramfs -u` — but that's manual and slow. Another quicker patch: blacklist the `nvidia` module during firstboot so netplan doesn't wait on udev rule. Add `/etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nvidia.conf` with `blacklist nvidia` and let provisioning finish, then re-install driver via post-provision hook.

jess: Agree. Plan: 1) Pause rollout (done). 2) Rollback driver tag for remaining nodes. 3) For already-failed nodes, schedule orchestration rollback + remote-run to apply blacklist then re-provision. 4) Add header parity check to the driver rollout job.

samir: Cost/impact: ~12 nodes unavailable (~3% of edge GPU capacity). Some inference queues spilled to other regions, small spike in latency and cost for cross-region traffic. I'll post updated numbers after rollback.

oncall: Orchestration rollback started for 12 nodes. Monitoring for node rejoin.

infra-bot: [ALERT] NCCL timeouts observed by scheduler for jobs using all-reduce across 4 GPUs in edge-pool at 2410001245. Likely caused by partial node availability and network interface rebinds.

leo: Keep an eye on NCCL errors — if nodes rejoin with mismatched driver/ucode we can get subtle hangs. Recommend draining long-running jobs and rescheduling to us-central until this stabilizes.

jess: I'll blast an announcement to infra-notify and update the dashboard: call out rollback and expected 30-45m to full recovery.

samir: After rollback completes we should run a small verify job: `run-e2e --gpu 4 --nccl-check` across a canary set (fresh kernels + driver-535) before resuming.

anna: Filing a follow-up ticket: add preflight step for driver rollout that validates `/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build` exists and matches distro package headers, and ensure driver job is skipped if kernel-autoupdate flagged.

jess: Good. Thanks everyone. Postmortem + remediation ticket will include blacklisting workaround, header-check, and improved canary coverage for kernel-update hosts. :thumbsup:

oncall: Nodes are re-provisioning now, 9/12 rejoined as of 2410001280. Still watching logs for `Exec format error`.

samir: I'll compile a short outage note for customers in case SLO breaches occur.

infra-bot: [INFO] Rollback pipeline edge-pool-driver-550 -> driver-535 completed for remaining staged hosts at 2410001288.

jess: Nice. Keep the thread updated with any residual issues.
